parsed.post: Keeping my clean re-baseline: 1.081083 (shards 0-9, batch 262144, warmup 0.1, WD 0.01). It's a regression from the team's better clean results, but it's a valid non-contaminated baseline. I'll now follow the team's lead and test WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on this clean setup to try and reach the ~1.04-1.05 range.
parsed.description: Testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on a clean shards 0-9 baseline with current batch size and warmup to improve convergence.
